entities.name: Great Mosque of Malatya
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Great Mosque of Malatya was a Seljuk mosque in Battalgazi, Malatya Province, Turkey. The mosque was originally built in the 13th century, and was destroyed in the 2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake.
